scope: Static/read-only repository logging contract; current local result ZIP inaccessible. No local-run numerical conclusions.

contract.supports: Launcher created the independent Python child; return record describes that process lifetime.
contract.does_not_support: Not MATLAB ready, not a native solver request or entry. Exit0 alone does not establish a valid pair.

contract.supports: Worker published READY after toolbox checkout/path check; bridge read it within its original deadline and checked release2023b before method flags become true.
contract.does_not_support: Legacy solver_started means ready only. A ready file alone does not prove Python accepted it in time or intlinprog was called.

contract.files_fields: request_N.event_*.json: kind=solver_entered; method/diagnostic_events.jsonl: worker_event_received with same request/event_number and method_elapsed_s; result.diagnostic.solver_entered_received_s; response.intlinprog_entered; result.integer_solver_entered
contract.supports: Worker reached the native-entry branch immediately before intlinprog; Recorder receipt adds a strict in-budget Python receive time. A response true or timely entry event supports the aggregate true.
contract.does_not_support: The flag/event is set/published just before the function call, so it does not prove rootLP, any numerical iteration or successful return. No event/response after a request is UNKNOWN, not confirmed no-entry.

contract.supports: False means no request attempts or every returned entry flag explicitly false; true may come from a timely immutable event; null preserves unconfirmed entry. Launcher crash/watchdog yields null.
contract.does_not_support: Request attempts, guard native_request_attempts, a .request.json file, crash or timeout do not prove native entry or non-entry. A guard count increments before native forwarding; it is not a solver-call completion count.

contract.topic: Fresh physical SAFE seed and same physical candidate
contract.supports: Full matching in-budget SAFE witness, numerical completion/decode roundtrip, frozen expected candidate/input identity and actual decodedx0 guard before first native request. OFF/ON vector lengths may differ for the same physical schedule.
contract.does_not_support: SAFE may remain the initial constructor solution even if native work fails. This is the common evaluator, not a second independent implementation; guard PASSED is not native x0 acceptance or proof of improvement.

contract.supports: The actual full floating vector satisfied the exported row/bound/integer checks without rounding/repair under ConstraintTolerance1e-9 and IntegerTolerance1e-6.
contract.does_not_support: No exact feasibility/thermal certificate and no MATLAB acceptance. An .initial.json rejected record also exists on admission failure; inspect accepted_numerically, not file existence.

contract.files_fields: request_N.input.json.initial_point; request_N.mat contains x0 and x0_validation; request_N.request.json published last; .python.json may say BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_BEFORE_PUBLICATION
contract.supports: Numerical payload was prepared; published MAT plus request indicates this request was offered to the worker. Original _InitialSession injects x0 into first solve only.
contract.does_not_support: Input metadata or MAT alone is not worker receipt. Counter increments before conversion/publication, so it can count an aborted attempt. Later rounds do not automatically receive the initial vector.

contract.supports: MATLAB loaded this request's x0 and passed initialPoint as the explicit argument if the native call branch was reached.
contract.does_not_support: The worker deliberately sets solver_acceptance=not_independently_observed and thermal_safe_claim=false. Merely received, returnedx matchingx0, or finite fval is not proof intlinprog adopted it as incumbent.

contract.supports: Keep any explicit native diagnostics and exact same-request context. A Python-admittedx0 plus native SOLVED/exitflag-2 forms a separate engineering status-conflict diagnostic.
contract.does_not_support: Current worker does not independently observe native x0 acceptance; no existing field can upgrade not_independently_observed to accepted. The status conflict is not a mathematical contradiction or infeasibility proof.

contract.files_fields: Raw callback state/values and callback_fields; final output/message/native.mat if present; MATLAB log may contain explicit diagnostic text
contract.supports: Only actual published raw solver-reported fields/text support the progress they explicitly describe. Preserve exact names/values and request identity.
contract.does_not_support: No dedicated rootLP-entered/completed flag or rootLP duration is instrumented. Native entry, zero callbacks/nodes, sparse log or waiting duration cannot distinguish rootLP from preprocessing/other native work or prove rootLP finished.

contract.files_fields: request_N.event_*.json.values; response.callbacks/callback_fields; response.output and native.mat output; diagnostic.solver_progress raw copies. Inspect only fields actually present (for example numnodes/lowerbound/relativegap/absolutegap).
contract.supports: They are solver-reported snapshots; event request_wall_seconds is native request-relative, Recorder method_elapsed_s is Python receive time. Keep objective/bound units and raw gap conventions intact.
contract.does_not_support: No callbacks/field is missing evidence, not numeric0. Generic Recorder does not derive/certify bounds or gaps. Never combine fullSAFE physicalUB with native fval/relativegap to reconstructLB: they may refer to different objectives/receipts. No global optimum, physicalenergy lower certificate, or rootLP completion follows from those numbers alone.

contract.supports: intlinprog_call measures MATLAB wall time around the call on a normal return; includes native callbacks/publications within that interval. Native MaxTime allocation is a limit, not observed duration.
contract.does_not_support: No completed timer if the call never returned/threw before assignment. Not CPUtime, not method wall time, and not rootLPtime. MaxTime may be much less than300 after prior costs.

contract.supports: Python requestwall includes transport+waiting+response read/archive context; wait phase polls Recorder, which may decode/evaluate callback candidates while MATLAB continues. Native requestwall includes MAT/options/call/archive; workerelapsed includes worker idle/other requests.
contract.does_not_support: Waiting phase is not pure solver or CPUtime and cannot identify a rootLP bottleneck. Timers overlap/nest; do not sum inclusive parents and children or cross-clock origins.

contract.topic: 300s method budget and outer process time
contract.supports: Original absolute MethodBudget starts before inputread, shares construction/MATLABstartup/freshinitialization/export/native work/full evaluation/feedback with no round reset. Imports precede it; cleanup/report are separate. Launcher has a420s watchdog.
contract.does_not_support: 300s is not native MaxTime300, a hard realtime process kill, or whole launched-Python walltime. Cleanup/archive are not additional search. Late native files remain diagnostics; in-budget receipts require timely full completion.

contract.topic: Returned native vector versus complete physical SAFE receipt
contract.supports: Only timely SOLVED nonemptyvector without status conflict becomes eligible for the common evaluator; full SAFE/rankable receipt completed before deadline establishes accepted physicalenergy. Candidate receipt/decode and evaluation have separate stamps.
contract.does_not_support: Native fval/incumbent or accepted_for_evaluation is not thermal SAFE. Top-level SAFE may come from initial_constructor; it alone cannot establish MILP improvement, native success or optimality.

contract.supports: COMPLETE requires guardPASSED, native entrytrue, complete cleanup and no flagged interface/numericalerror. OFF invalid/cleanupunconfirmed blocks ON. VALID_PAIR means both bounded one-shot invocations passed the launcher gate.
contract.does_not_support: Not proof of optimization success, improvement, native x0acceptance or globaloptimality. Crash/watchdog preserves unknown nativeentry; no automatic resume/reset or retries; do not infer missing ON ran.

off.timing_limit: No MATLAB startup/solve occurred. The initialization SAFE time is a construction diagnostic, not formal first-SAFE performance.

on.timing_limit: No MATLAB startup/solve occurred. The initialization SAFE time is a construction diagnostic, not formal first-SAFE performance.
